mentions.name: Pyridine derivatives plant yield optimization
mentions.description: This effort helps a pyridine derivatives chemical plant optimize yields and reduce losses across multiple stages of reactions spanning feedstock and reagents.
mentions.problem: Suboptimal yields and losses across multiple stages of chemical reactions involving feedstock and reagents.
mentions.source_excerpt: I inherited a stake in a pyridine derivatives chemical plant - while I do not know much about chemical feedstocks and the chemical supply chain, I am trying to help the current partner optimize their yields and reduce losses across multiple stages of reactions across the feedstock and reagents.
